title: Exploring the Robustness of Model-Graded Evaluations and Automated Interpretability
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures robustness to prompt injections in model-graded evaluations for deception, humor, and arithmetic tasks.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a topic of study.
